jobs.direction: Make the silhouette more squat and broad: thick shoulders framing a small lowered skull head, the giant armored right arm a single massive readable shape, the opposite claw separated clearly from the thigh. Keep the same asymmetric mechanical arm, pale corrupted flesh, dark olive plates, restrained red cables.
jobs.prompt: EDIT TARGET is the supplied original Project RL monster. Create ONE proposed silhouette-readability revision of THIS SAME creature for a grimdark futuristic/cyberpunk 2D roguelike. Preserve its monster identity, equipment, limb count, materials, original palette and exact frontal/slightly-top sprite view. Make the silhouette more squat and broad: thick shoulders framing a small lowered skull head, the giant armored right arm a single massive readable shape, the opposite claw separated clearly from the thigh. Keep the same asymmetric mechanical arm, pale corrupted flesh, dark olive plates, restrained red cables. The final sprite will appear around 60-76 pixels tall over a 64px logical grid, so use large clear masses, quiet surfaces, broad restrained highlights, very few cracks or tiny specks. Flesh looks like flesh and metal looks like matte metal, not cracked stone. Keep the original hand-painted game finish, irregular dark contour and solid shaded volumes; do not make a flat cartoon or a sketch. These three distinct roles must be recognized instantly by shape. Keep FULL BODY including every finger, claw, foot and weapon visible with generous transparent margin. Absolutely transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no scene, no text, no glow or magical effects. Do not add new anatomy or powers.

jobs.direction: Make the silhouette distinctly lean, forward-hunched and predatory, with two long separated forearms, three broad claws on each hand, a single clear pale crescent head crest and simple ivory shoulder plates. Preserve original dark organic flesh and ivory bone anatomy. Avoid confusing the head with the shoulders.
